ruleDefinitions.name: Service Installation Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: This rule detects attempts to install services using 'systemctl start', 'systemctl enable', 'service start', or 'chkconfig on' commands. This could be indicative of an attacker trying to persist on the system.

sequences.query:
process_command_line:("systemctl","service","chkconfig")
AND
process_command_line:(" start"," enable"," on") AND NOT vendor: "Microsoft"
